package spend

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func (c composeClient) deadlines(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"configured-timeout", "caller-deadline", "caller-cancel"} {
		// A native client's context is a wire-client deadline, not a server context
		// injection. Configured timeout below runs on the actual native server.
		if c.native != nil && mode != "configured-timeout" {
			continue
		}
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			call := c
			stop := func() {}
			expected := error(context.DeadlineExceeded)
			duration := 30 * time.Second
			if mode == "caller-deadline" {
				duration = 100 * time.Millisecond
				call.ctx, stop = context.WithTimeout(c.ctx, duration)
			}
			if mode == "caller-cancel" {
				expected = context.Canceled
				call.ctx, stop = context.WithCancel(c.ctx)
			}
			defer stop()
			entered := make(chan struct{}, 1)
			observations.Lock()
			observations.values = nil
			observations.entered = entered
			observations.Unlock()
			type response struct {
				data   []byte
				failed bool
				err    error
			}
			done := make(chan response, 1)
			start := time.Now()
			go func() { data, failed, err := call.call(call.arguments("wait")); done <- response{data, failed, err} }()
			select {
			case <-entered:
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("predicate not entered")
			}
			if mode == "caller-cancel" {
				stop()
			}
			var result response
			select {
			case result = <-done:
			case <-time.After(35 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("compose ignored deadline/cancellation")
			}
			if result.err != nil || !result.failed {
				t.Fatalf("expected finalized timeout: body=%s failed=%v err=%v", result.data, result.failed, result.err)
			}
			var body map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(result.data, &body); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if body["data"] != nil {
				t.Fatalf("partial data after timeout/cancellation: %s", result.data)
			}
			elapsed := time.Since(start)
			if mode != "caller-cancel" && elapsed < duration-20*time.Millisecond {
				t.Fatalf("returned before configured deadline: %v", elapsed)
			}
			if mode != "configured-timeout" && elapsed > 3*time.Second {
				t.Fatalf("caller context lost: %v", elapsed)
			}
			observations.Lock()
			events := append([]frameObservation(nil), observations.values...)
			observations.entered = nil
			observations.Unlock()
			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Frame.Frame != 1 || !errors.Is(events[0].Err, expected) {
				t.Fatalf("timeout frame evidence=%+v expected=%v", events, expected)
			}
			if mode == "caller-deadline" {
				deadline, _ := call.ctx.Deadline()
				if !events[0].Deadline.Equal(deadline) {
					t.Fatalf("earlier deadline replaced: %s want=%s", events[0].Deadline, deadline)
				}
			}
			t.Logf("%s reached authored predicate, stopped before frame 2 with %v after %v", mode, events[0].Err, elapsed)
		})
	}
}
